title: Label as News, then “Always” makes a rule (fake data)
steps: Launch with -UseFakeData, focus a conversation with an auto label and run Label as News from ⌘K
In the toast “Always label News for:” click This list (or This sender when there is no list)
Open Settings › Importance & labels › Rules, then press ⌘Z twice in the mail window
expected: The chip becomes News at once. Nothing is saved until the toast's button is clicked; then a rule appears under Your rules. The first ⌘Z removes the rule, the second takes the label back.
